title: Tuesday · place value, stories & getting connected
arrival: Photo Day! We will pause when called. Finish both Discovery and Truth and Reconciliation booklets before orange-shirt decorations.
note: Planned September 22. Full teaching steps, answers and setup: docs/TUESDAY_2026-09-22.md. Photo time unknown.

blocks.title: Welcome & settle in
studentSteps: Unpack and have a pencil ready. Continue your Discovery booklet or read quietly.

blocks.title: Attendance, forms & booklet check-in
studentSteps: Attendance first; then hand in information forms and device agreements.
Submit finished Discovery work, or show what you still need to finish.

blocks.title: Discovery booklets · finish & submit
studentSteps: Finish your agreed Discovery work and check it with the teacher.
If Discovery is finished, continue the Truth and Reconciliation pages already introduced.
Both booklets finished? Choose an orange-shirt design and explain it.

blocks.title: Math · place value & a possible decimal step
blocks.notes: Check understanding before decimals. Finished math posts next week.
studentSteps: Show 6,307 on a place-value chart. Explain the 3 and the zero.
Write it in expanded form. How are neighbouring places related?
Practise with a partner; show your thinking.
Ready? Extend our chart to tenths and hundredths.

blocks.title: Snack & recess preparation
studentSteps: Put math away and eat your snack.
Clean your space and prepare for recess.

blocks.title: Evidence · how do we know?
blocks.notes: Use the quick game only; return to booklets at 11:05.
studentSteps: Read the source. Choose A, B or C and point to a detail.
Explain: I think… The source tells us… This supports my idea because…

blocks.title: Language Arts + Social Studies · Truth and Reconciliation
blocks.notes: Select and model one response; see teaching reference.
studentSteps: Read the selected booklet passage with a partner.
What does this account help us understand about why remembrance matters?
Use a detail and explain the connection. Point, talk, draw or write.

blocks.title: Share one supported response
blocks.notes: Collect one response for both subjects; oral responses count.
studentSteps: Share your idea, source detail and explanation.
Keep this response for our SpacesEDU practice when access is ready.

blocks.title: Nevermoor · audiobook & discussion
studentSteps: Recall our last scene. Listen for a character’s feelings.
What story detail supports your idea? Explain why.

blocks.title: French/Health · Mr. Eckert
studentSteps: Follow Mr. Eckert’s directions and have your materials ready.

blocks.title: Laptops · sign in, SpacesEDU & optional Blooket
blocks.notes: Login 12 min; SpacesEDU 15; game up to 8; return 5. Preview Blooket first; drop it if delayed.
studentSteps: Sign in with your own login. Keep passwords private.
If access is ready, post your booklet response: idea, detail and explanation. Otherwise save it in class.
If time, join Blooket with a partner or your device.
Sign out and return your laptop.

blocks.title: Classroom care
studentSteps: Restore your workspace and return shared materials.
Check that devices are signed out and put away.

blocks.title: Planners, final jobs & pack-up
studentSteps: Record reminders and return any outstanding forms when ready.
No school Friday, September 25.
Finish your jobs, pack your belongings and get ready for dismissal.

backups: Pause for photos; resume Nevermoor with everyone back.
Later: Five Agreements, NVC and The Secret Path before the September 28 walk.
If time: reviewed Blooket, reading, colouring or partner puzzles. No gym block confirmed.
